countryCode.description: For countries, use the country abbreviation. Default `US`. Optional values: `US`, `JP`, `DE`

keyword.description: Keywords (required, and according to the selected country, translate the keywords into the language of the corresponding country)

launchDateMax.description: The maximum shelf time, the format is: `yyyyMMdd000000`

launchDateMin.description: Minimum shelf time, the format is: `yyyyMMdd000000`

sellerCountry.description: Seller's country and region code. If multiple selections are made, separate them with commas, such as: `CN,US`

sortField.description: Sort field. Default `purchasedClicksT360`. Optional values: `totalReviews` (total number of comments), `price` (price), `launchDate` (listing time), `clickCountT7` (7-day clicks), `clickCountT30` (30-day clicks), `clickCountT90` (90-day clicks), `clickConversionRate` (click-to-purchase conversion rate), `clickConversionRateComposite` (comprehensive click-to-purchase) conversion rate), `customerRating` (rating), `purchasedClicksT360` (360-day purchase volume), `clickCountGrowthT7` (weekly click growth rate), `clickCountGrowthT30` (monthly clicks Growth rate), `currentPrice` (current price), `fbaFee` (FBA commission), `shippingFee` (FBA freight), `gpm` (gross profit margin)

sortType.description: Sort by. Default `desc`. Optional values: `desc` (descending order), `asc` (ascending order)
